title: Famous software and the language it is written in

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?langLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?d) AS ?lang) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?nL) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?cls ; wdt:P277 ?d ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . VALUES ?cls { wd:Q271680 wd:Q188860 wd:Q1330336 wd:Q7397 wd:Q9135 wd:Q1301371 } ?d wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q9143 . FILTER(?sl >= 40) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nL = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
